name: Aqua (Water)
description: Solvent and base for formulations.

name: Glycerin
description: Humectant that attracts and retains moisture.

name: Petrolatum
description: Occlusive that locks in moisture and repairs barrier.

name: Cocoa Butter (Theobroma Cacao Seed Butter)
description: Emollient; nourishing and improves skin elasticity.

name: Shea Butter (Butyrospermum Parkii Butter)
description: Rich emollient with skin-soothing properties.

name: Dimethicone
description: Silicone that smooths skin and provides protective film.

name: Isopropyl Palmitate
description: Emollient; can be comedogenic for some skin types.

name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
description: Improves tone, barrier function, and reduces redness.

name: Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)
description: Antioxidant; brightening and anti-oxidative benefits.

name: Fragrance (Parfum)
description: Blend of aromatic ingredients; common allergen.

name: Linalool
description: Fragrance component; can oxidize and cause sensitivity.

name: Limonene
description: Fragrance terpene; oxidizes to potential sensitiser.

name: Hydroxycitronellal
description: Fragrance allergen; may trigger dermatitis.

name: Hexyl Cinnamal
description: Fragrance allergen; potential sensitiser.

name: Butylphenyl Methylpropional (Lilial)
description: Fragrance ingredient with sensitization concerns.

name: Methylparaben
description: Paraben preservative; debated endocrine concerns.

name: Propylparaben
description: Paraben preservative; debated endocrine concerns.

name: DMDM Hydantoin
description: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative; can irritate or sensitize.

name: Phenoxyethanol
description: Common preservative; generally low irritation in recommended concentrations.

name: Sodium Benzoate
description: Water-soluble preservative; generally regarded as safe at permitted levels.

name: BHT (Butylated Hydroxytoluene)
description: Antioxidant with some long-term toxicity concerns.

name: Titanium Dioxide
description: Physical UV filter and pigment; safe on skin but inhalation risk as powder.

name: Zinc Oxide
description: Physical sunscreen ingredient; broad-spectrum UV protection.

name: Octocrylene
description: Chemical UV filter; potential photoallergenic reactions in some.

name: Avobenzone
description: Chemical UVA filter; can be unstable unless stabilized.

name: Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate)
description: Powerful humectant; hydrates and plumps skin.

name: Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate
description: Mild surfactant and cleanser.

name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES)
description: Foaming surfactant; can be irritating to sensitive skin.

name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS)
description: Strong surfactant; higher irritation potential.

name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
description: Amphoteric surfactant; mild but can contain impurities in poor-quality batches.

name: Alcohol Denat. (SD Alcohol)
description: Solvent that can cause dryness or irritation in some users.

name: Cetyl Alcohol
description: Fatty alcohol; emollient and thickener (non-drying).

name: Stearyl Alcohol
description: Fatty alcohol used as an emollient and thickener.

name: Cetearyl Alcohol
description: Blend of cetyl and stearyl alcohol; emollient and stabilizer.

name: Stearic Acid
description: Fatty acid used as thickener and emulsifier.

name: Myristic Acid
description: Fatty acid; used in cleansers and creams; may be pore-clogging for some.

name: Lactic Acid
description: Alpha hydroxy acid (AHA); exfoliant and humectant.

name: Glycolic Acid
description: AHA exfoliant; effective but can cause sensitivity if overused.

name: Salicylic Acid
description: Beta hydroxy acid (BHA); oil-soluble exfoliant for acne-prone skin.

name: Benzoyl Peroxide
description: Topical anti-acne agent; can be drying and bleaching to fabrics.

name: Retinol (Vitamin A)
description: Anti-aging active; can cause irritation and sun sensitivity.

name: Retinyl Palmitate
description: Vitamin A ester; milder retinoid-like effects.

name: Panthenol (Provitamin B5)
description: Soothing humectant and skin conditioner.

name: Allantoin
description: Soothing, anti-irritant ingredient.

name: Sodium Hydroxide
description: pH adjuster; used in small amounts.

name: Carbomer
description: Thickening polymer used to create gels and creams.

name: Triethanolamine (TEA)
description: pH adjuster and emulsifier; can irritate in high concentrations.

name: Polysorbate 20
description: Emulsifier and solubilizer for fragrances and oils.

name: Polysorbate 80
description: Emulsifier and surfactant.

name: Sodium PCA
description: Natural moisturizing factor component; hydrates skin.

name: Urea
description: Kerato-regulator and humectant; helps with rough, dry skin.

name: Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
description: Antioxidant; skin-conditioning agent.

name: Panax Ginseng Root Extract
description: Botanical extract used for revitalising properties.

name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
description: Soothing botanical extract with humectant properties.

name: Ceteareth-20
description: Emulsifier; can be contaminated with 1,4-dioxane if poorly manufactured.

name: Sodium Chloride
description: Thickener and electrolyte; common salt.

name: PEG-100 Stearate
description: Emulsifier; PEGs can carry contamination concerns in low-quality sources.

name: Hexylene Glycol
description: Solvent and viscosity control agent.

name: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
description: Light emollient derived from coconut and glycerin.

name: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil
description: Light oil; good skin compatibility.

name: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil
description: Emollient oil rich in fatty acids.

name: Cocoglycerides
description: Emollients and skin-conditioning agents.

name: Phenylpropanol
description: Preservative/solvent; low irritation potential.

name: Ethylhexylglycerin
description: Skin-conditioning agent and preservative booster.

name: Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (Octinoxate)
description: Chemical UVB filter; controversial for coral reefs and hormone disruption studies.

name: Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone)
description: UVA filter; see avobenzone entry.

name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
description: Stable vitamin C derivative; antioxidant and brightening.

name: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
description: Stable vitamin C derivative with skin-brightening properties.

name: Copper Peptides (GHK-Cu)
description: Bioactive peptides used in anti-aging; potent but can be expensive.

name: Niacinamide (duplicate)
description: Included for mapping convenience.

name: Glyceryl Stearate
description: Emulsifier and skin-conditioning agent.

name: PEG-6
description: PEG solvent; low risk but manufacturing impurities possible.

name: Hydroquinone
description: Strong skin-lightening agent; banned/restricted in many markets due to safety concerns.

name: Mercury (in illicit formulations)
description: Highly toxic; illegally used in some counterfeit fairness creams.

name: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer
description: Long-lasting hyaluronic acid derivative for sustained hydration.

name: Cinnamal (Cinnamyl Alcohol)
description: Fragrance component; potential allergen.

name: Coumarin
description: Fragrance allergen; possible sensitiser.

name: Menthol
description: Cooling agent; can irritate sensitive skin.

name: Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract
description: Antioxidant botanical extract; soothing.

name: Sodium Metabisulfite
description: Antioxidant/preservative; sulfite sensitivity possible.
